syllabus_topics: Introduction to computer networks and the Internet: packet switching; layered architecture; services; interfaces and protocols; physical infrastructure of the Internet; performance metrics.
Application layer: the Web and HTTP; FTP; SMTP; DNS; the socket interface.
Transport layer: multiplexing; reliable data transfer; flow control, congestion control; UDP and TCP protocols.
Network layer: IP addresses and prefixes; routing protocols: RIP, OSPF, BGP; private networks and NAT; DHCP, ICMP protocols; multicast.
Data link layer: the ARP protocol; error control; medium access control protocols: ALOHA, CSMA/CD, CSMA/CA; switched local networks; virtualization.
assessment_rules: For the normal period, the final grade is calculated as Exam (minimum 7 points) 45% + Continuous Assessment 55%. For student workers, continuous assessment is conducted during the normal period. For the resit period, the final grade is the maximum of {Exam (minimum 7 points) 55%; Exam (minimum 7 points) 45% + electronic questionnaires 10%} + Laboratory component 45%. For the special period, the final grade is Exam (minimum 7 points) 55% + Laboratory component 45%. Exceptionally, if a student could not attend labs and do the project during the normal period, they will complete a project to be agreed upon with the instructor, in which case the exam is 80% and the project is 20%. An oral defense is required for a final grade > 18, otherwise a grade of 18 will be assigned.
